projects.title: Website Portal Generator
projects.shortDescription: Implemented a backend system and developed a dynamic website portal generator with focus on UX/UI design.

description: The Website Portal Generator is a full-stack web application that allows users to dynamically create and customize website portals without coding knowledge. Built as part of the UCL COMP0016 Systems Engineering module, this project was developed in partnership with an industry client.
The platform provides an intuitive drag-and-drop interface for building professional-looking portals, complete with customizable themes, widgets, and content blocks.

This project was developed to address the need for non-technical users to create professional web portals without requiring development expertise. Many organizations struggle with the complexity of building and maintaining internal portals.
why.problem: Organizations often need internal portals for communication, resource sharing, and team collaboration, but lack the technical resources to build custom solutions. Existing tools are either too complex or too limited in customization.
why.role: I led the front-end development with a focus on UX/UI design using Figma for prototyping. I ensured seamless integration between the frontend and backend, leveraging modern web technologies to enhance user experience.

process.description: Conducted user research and created personas to understand target users' needs
Created wireframes and high-fidelity prototypes in Figma, iterating based on feedback
Built responsive UI components with vanilla JavaScript and CSS
Developed RESTful APIs and integrated with the frontend
Conducted usability testing and fixed issues based on user feedback
Deployed the application and presented to industry partners

how.challenges: One major challenge was implementing the drag-and-drop functionality while maintaining performance. I solved this by using efficient DOM manipulation techniques and implementing virtual scrolling for large content areas.

outcomes: Successfully delivered a fully functional portal generator
Received positive feedback from industry partners
Improved my skills in UX/UI design and frontend development
Gained experience working in an agile team environment
results.learnings: This project taught me the importance of user-centered design and iterative development. Working with real industry partners gave me valuable experience in understanding client requirements and delivering solutions that meet their needs.

projects.title: Reduce Food Wastage App
projects.shortDescription: Engineered a web application optimizing UX/UI design principles for an intuitive user experience.

description: The Reduce Food Wastage App is a web application designed to help households and businesses track their food inventory, receive expiration alerts, and discover recipes based on ingredients that are about to expire.
The app provides an intuitive interface for users to manage their food items, set reminders, and make informed decisions about meal planning to minimize waste.
features: Food inventory tracking with expiration dates
Smart notifications for items nearing expiration
Recipe suggestions based on available ingredients
Barcode scanning for easy item entry

description: Food waste is a significant global problem, with approximately one-third of all food produced being wasted. This not only has economic implications but also environmental consequences, contributing to greenhouse gas emissions.
why.problem: Many households throw away food simply because they forget what's in their fridge or don't know how to use ingredients before they expire. There's a need for a simple, user-friendly solution to help people track and manage their food inventory.
why.role: I served as the Pitching and Front-end Team Lead. I was responsible for leading the UX/UI design, developing the frontend, and presenting the project to judges.

process.description: Rapid wireframing and design in Figma

how.challenges: The biggest challenge was building a functional MVP within 24 hours. We prioritized core features and used rapid prototyping techniques.

outcomes: Successfully delivered a working prototype in 24 hours
Received positive feedback from hackathon judges
Demonstrated potential societal impact of the solution
Strengthened teamwork and rapid development skills
results.learnings: This hackathon taught me the importance of prioritization and rapid iteration. Working under extreme time pressure forced us to focus on what truly matters to users.

projects.title: Jia Studying Platform
projects.shortDescription: Built and grew a personal brand with 22k+ followers and collaborations with 250+ organizations.

description: Jia Studying is a personal brand and content platform focused on education, productivity, and student life. What started as a passion project has grown into a thriving online business with a global reach.
The platform spans multiple social media channels and includes an e-commerce component, offering curated products and resources for students.
features: Social Media Presence: Educational and lifestyle content across multiple platforms
Online Store: Curated study supplies and productivity tools
Community: Engaged audience of students and young professionals

description: I started Jia Studying during the pandemic in 2020, initially as a way to share my study tips and connect with other students during a time of isolation.
why.problem: There was a gap in authentic, relatable content for students navigating university life.
why.role: Founder and sole creator - responsible for content strategy, creation, partnerships, and business operations.

process.description: Started during pandemic, focused on study content
Reached first 5k followers, first brand collaboration
Crossed 15k followers, partnered with major brands

how.challenges: Balancing content creation with studies and work while maintaining consistent quality and authenticity.

outcomes: Built a following of 22,000+ engaged followers
results.learnings: Running Jia Studying has taught me invaluable entrepreneurial skills that complement my technical background - marketing, business development, customer relations, and personal branding.
